definition: American Welding Society codes define technical requirements for welding work within their specified scopes.
entry_text: American Welding Society codes define technical requirements for welding work within their specified scopes.
example: A welding inspector consults the applicable code when reviewing structural weld acceptance.
label: American Welding Society codes

sources.note: The issuing organization identifies its standards for welding practices and procedures and emphasizes that requirements apply within each document’s scope. This does not mean that every code is automatically a legal requirement.
